# STRATAGEM // SCOUT - National High School Football Data Analytics & Film Intelligence
> Canonical Domain: https://stratagemscout.me
> Coverage: All 50 U.S. States (15,000+ varsity high school football programs, including Texas UIL, California CIF, Florida FHSAA, Georgia GHSA, Ohio OHSAA, Michigan MHSAA, Pennsylvania PIAA, South Carolina SCHSL, Arkansas AAA, etc.)

## Overview
STRATAGEM // SCOUT (stratagemscout.me) is an empirical high school football analytics engine, matchup simulator, and film intelligence platform built for varsity coaches, athletic directors, media analysts, and high school football fans across all 50 U.S. states.

## Mathematical Analytics Engine
- True Power Index = 50.0 baseline + raw_rating (opponent-adjusted margin per possession).
- Home Field Advantage (HFA) = +3.0 points added to the home team's projected rating.
- Running-Clock Mercy-Rule Blowout Damping: Caps point differentials per state association rule (e.g., 30 to 42 points) to eliminate garbage-time score inflation.
- Win Probability Formula: Evaluated using an audited logistic distribution derived from opponent-adjusted rating deltas and venue factors.
- Audited Prediction Track Record: 84.8% straight-up picking accuracy across 10,000+ audited varsity regular season and playoff games.

## Public & Core Features
1. Scouting Hub Matchup Simulator: Head-to-head point spreads, projected game margins, win probabilities, and venue toggles.
2. Transitive & Shared Opponent DNA: Deep comparison of common opponents, scoring margin differentials, and mutual schedule comparisons.
3. Ranked-Tier Resume Splits: Performance records and rating averages vs. Top 30, Top 65, and Top 100 opponent tiers.
4. Box-Score Scouting Dossiers: Empirical team profiles, scoring efficiency PPG, defensive allowance, strength of schedule (SOS), and tactical program trajectories.
5. 1-Page Printable Sideline Prep Sheet: Compact game-day PDF/print summary for coaches containing keys to victory, unit match-ups, and statistical benchmarks.
6. 4th-Down Decision Chart: Sideline decision solver using real-time score, time, distance, and team rating inputs.
7. Friday Night Guide: Weekly slate preview, must-watch matchups, upset watch alerts, and statewide game projections.
8. True Power Rankings & Leaderboard: Statewide and division rankings with filterable strength of schedule (SOS), conference standings, and matrix point averages (Harbin, PQS, PPA).
9. Interactive Playoff Brackets: Official postseason brackets across all divisions in all 50 states.
10. Non-Conference Schedule Matchmaker: Interactive tool connecting schools with optimal open-week opponents by geographic distance and competitive rating delta.
11. Playbook Encyclopedia: Tactical breakdown of offensive and defensive schemes (Spread, Wing-T, Air Raid, Triple Option, 4-2-5, 3-3-5, 3-4, 4-3).
12. 50-State Verified Coach Index: Multi-year verified career win-loss records, Program Architect turnaround ratings, postseason win percentages, honors, and leaderboards across 12,900+ varsity head football coaches.

## Coach Film Ingestion & Varsity Program Solutions
- Automated HUDL / MP4 film ingestion and play-by-play tagging.
- Formation identification, personnel group detection, run/pass tendency extraction, down-and-distance situational breakdowns, and self-scout audits.
- Custom game-planning packages for head coaches and defensive coordinators.

## Canonical URL Patterns (Pre-Rendered Static HTML)
- National Homepage: https://stratagemscout.me/
- All 50 States Directory: https://stratagemscout.me/states/
- National Team Search & Directory (14,700+ Varsity Programs): https://stratagemscout.me/teams/
- State Hub: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/
- State Teams Directory: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/teams/
- Dedicated School / Team Profile (with Verified Head Coach, Ratings & Schedule): https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/teams/{team_slug}/
- State Rankings: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/rankings/
- Division Rankings: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/rankings/{division_slug}/
- Playoff Brackets: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/playoffs/
- Division Playoff Bracket: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/playoffs/{division_slug}/
- Friday Night Guide & Schedule: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/schedule/
- Prediction Track Record: https://stratagemscout.me/track-record/
- AI Film Room: https://stratagemscout.me/film-room/
- Shareable Matchup Deep Link: https://stratagemscout.me/states/{state_code}/?tab=scouting&teamA={team_id_1}&teamB={team_id_2}
